checklist: cert/import.mjs: import numpy from /node_modules/@ai-ecoverse/py-numpy, found by discovery without PYTHONPATH, no nested python; its 19 side modules import

cert/numpy.mjs: linalg.solve [1,2,3] (residual < 1e-12), det 40, inv, eigvalsh [1,3] (OpenBLAS), matmul, einsum 506, fft [10, -2+2j, -2, -2-2j], default_rng(42).integers [89, 773, 654, 438, 433], int32 * float32 -> float64
cert/numpy.mjs: importlib.metadata lists numpy 2.5.4's entry points (array_api, console_scripts f2py/numpy-config, pkg_config, pyinstaller40), as the sdist's pyproject.toml declares them (#1084)

2.3.2-12 (homescoop#1082, refs #1081): cert/linalg-errors.mjs. A singular solve and inv raise LinAlgError('Singular matrix') for float64, float32, complex128 and one singular matrix in a batch; a non-PD cholesky raises LinAlgError('Matrix is not positive definite'). A good matrix solves to [2, 3], before and after a failure. -11 returns NaN for all of them (NEGATIVE.md)
python-range.mjs (homescoop#702): the tarball takes wasix-python >=3.15.0-1 <3.15.1 (it is built against 3.15.0-1's headers)

2.5.4-1 (homescoop#761, the cp315 wave; npm-tag python3.15): numpy 2.5.4 from the PyPI sdist (9a94cf75…) against wasix-python 3.15.0-1, Cython 3.3.0, wasix-sysroot -38 (libc++ headers from the sysroot, phase B). The wasm-cpu and fp-exceptions patches are upstream in 2.5.4 and drop. cblas-int-returns, no-backtrace and linalg-errors (#1082) carry over, all mapped in patches. Every cp314 spec, cert/linalg-errors.mjs included

2.5.4-2 (homescoop#761, the fold): packages/py-numpy3.15 moved over packages/py-numpy after the python3.15 -> latest flip; no npm-tag, the recipe and package name lose the 3.15 suffix (package.json homescoop.recipe, repository.directory), so the revision moves on; same sources and build as 2.5.4-1; every spec as before

cert/notices.mjs (homescoop#726, #1079): THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md names OpenBLAS, LAPACK and GotoBLAS2 (from @ai-ecoverse/wasix-openblas' LICENSE), libdivide, and the vendored code numpy compiles in: pocketfft (numpy.fft), Highway (Apache-2.0 OR BSD-3-Clause), the numpy.random bit generators MT19937, PCG64, Philox, SFC64, SplitMix64 (CC0) and distributions, each with its licence text

cert/wasm32.mjs (homescoop#1081, #1093, documented in the README): np.intp is 4 bytes and the default integer int32, dtype=np.int64 sums past 2**31 (2449965000); 1.0/0 and sqrt(-1) give inf/nan with no RuntimeWarning and errstate(all='raise') doesn't raise (no FP status flags on wasm; LinAlgError works, linalg-errors.mjs)

cert/signatures.mjs (homescoop#1083): the seven entry points that trapped (function signature mismatch) return: five private/test ones and two public ones, copy.copy() of a numpy scalar and setting ndarray.dtype; numpy-wasm-call-signatures.patch; build.sh's wasm-call-signatures.mjs run fails the build on a mismatch (was || echo)
cert/numpy.mjs (homescoop#1088): np.show_config()'s compiler and linker args name no /tmp, /home or /Users path and no -ffile-prefix-map (build.sh drops the map from __config__.py)

cert/linalg-large.mjs: eigh, svd and eigvalsh of 26x26, 64x64 and 200x200 matrices reconstruct (dsyevd/dgesdd divide and conquer, n > 25, the path wasix-openblas 0.3.34's laed3 int-ABI fix covers; 2.5.4-2's own 0.3.28 passes too, so this guards the switch)

2.5.4-3: OpenBLAS from @ai-ecoverse/wasix-openblas 0.3.34-1 (static PIC, C LAPACK, f2c int ABI; was a 0.3.28 build of tools/build-openblas.sh inside this recipe): wasix-openblas has 0.3.34's laed3 int-ABI fix, so dsyevd for n > 25 no longer traps, and no OS_EMBEDDED puts/printf/getenv/atoi stubs; certs on wasix-python 3.15.0-3. Same numpy sources

patches.numpy-wasix-no-backtrace.patch: cert/patches.mjs: a + b + c on 2^18 float64 (temporary elision's caller check) works and _multiarray_umath doesn't name backtrace
patches.numpy-wasm-linalg-errors.patch: cert/linalg-errors.mjs: singular solve/inv and a non-PD cholesky raise LinAlgError through _umath_linalg's wasm failure flag (#1082)
patches.numpy-wasm-call-signatures.patch: seven C entry points get the arity CPython calls them with (homescoop#1083): the array_converter.scalar_input and _BoundArrayMethod._supports_unaligned getters, the ndarray.dtype setter, _get_castingimpl, sfloat and generic-scalar __reduce__/__copy__, _multiarray_tests.format_float_OSprintf_g; cert/signatures.mjs calls each, build.sh fails on any call-signature mismatch
